sourceFull: Data: Deccan Herald (Jul 2025); World Bank, What a Waste 2.0

segs.text: Every day, Bengaluru throws away more than six thousand tonnes of waste.
parts: Every day, Bengaluru throws away more than six thousand tonnes of waste.

segs.text: That's heavier than a thousand elephants. Every single day.
parts: That's heavier than a thousand elephants. Every single day.

segs.text: And too much of it ends up where we walk: on footpaths, in corners, in empty plots.
parts: And too much of it ends up where we walk:
on footpaths, in corners, in empty plots.

segs.text: Garbage isn't one problem. It's homes, collectors, trucks, sorting centres and recyclers, each working alone, each blind to the others.
parts: It's homes, collectors, trucks, sorting centres and recyclers, each working alone, each blind to the others.

segs.text: And this isn't just Bengaluru. The world throws away about two billion tonnes a year, and that could reach three point four billion by twenty fifty.
parts: And this isn't just Bengaluru. The world throws away about two billion tonnes a year,
and that could reach three point four billion by twenty fifty.

segs.text: What if every link in the chain could see the whole chain?
parts: What if every link in the chain could see the whole chain?

segs.text: Pickups planned around what each street actually needs. Every load tracked, from doorstep to recycler. Collectors paid fairly, and on time.
parts: Pickups planned around what each street actually needs.
Every load tracked, from doorstep to recycler.
Collectors paid fairly, and on time.

segs.text: A.L.K.I. is being designed to plan systems like this. OmniChain, to keep a record no one can quietly edit. And OmniBot is being built for the dirty, dangerous work no one should have to do.
parts: A.L.K.I. is being designed to plan systems like this.
OmniChain, to keep a record no one can quietly edit.
And OmniBot is being built for the dirty, dangerous work no one should have to do.

segs.text: No one fixes this alone. It takes residents, workers, recyclers, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
parts: It takes residents, workers, recyclers, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.

segs.text: In nature, there is no waste. Everything returns to the cycle.
parts: In nature, there is no waste. Everything returns to the cycle.

segs.text: Six thousand tonnes a day. Let's turn it back into a cycle.
parts: Six thousand tonnes a day. Let's turn it back into a cycle.
